mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines for corporate investments and shareholder returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 245.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 245.0, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 but directional accuracy is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive earnings channel.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which drive aggregate demand and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economic expansion gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 100,000 new jobs (PAYEMS > 145000) indicates a rapidly strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 145000, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS signal is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 17000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 17000) signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 17000, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
